module_summary: Source side of a 4-phase CDC handshake: a 3-state FSM samples data on valid, drives a glitch-free registered req and data, and waits on a synchronized ack.

anchors.name: state_q
anchors.why: IDLE/WAIT_ACK_ASSERT/WAIT_ACK_DEASSERT handshake FSM; drives ready_o and req.

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Source valid; in IDLE samples data_i and starts request.

anchors.name: ready_o
anchors.why: Source ready decoded from FSM state and synced ack.

anchors.name: data_i
anchors.why: Input payload sampled into data_src on valid in IDLE.

anchors.name: async_req_o
anchors.why: Asynchronous 4-phase request to destination, from req_src_q.

anchors.name: async_ack_i
anchors.why: Asynchronous ack from destination, synchronized by i_sync.

anchors.name: async_data_o
anchors.why: Asynchronous data output held stable from data_src_q.

anchors.name: data_src_q
anchors.why: Holds sampled data across the whole handshake.

anchors.name: req_src_q
anchors.why: Registered request filtering combinational glitches before async_req_o.

anchors.name: ack_synced
anchors.why: Synchronized ack steering FSM transitions and ready_o.

groups.name: Handshake FSM
groups.description: 4-phase req/ack sequencer driving request and ready.

groups.name: Ack synchronizer
groups.description: tc_sync multi-stage synchronizer for async ack.

groups.name: Data holding
groups.description: Captures data_i and holds it stable on async_data_o.
